name: plugin.doc_synchronizer
description: Repository documentation coverage auditing, AST code-to-doc symbol drift verification, Diataxis scaffolding, and interactive visual brief generation
author: Brain Harness

entrypoints.name: doc_audit
entrypoints.description: Audit Python codebase and calculate documentation coverage metrics with AST symbol depth

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Target directory or package path to audit

entrypoints.name: doc_drift_check
entrypoints.description: Verify markdown documentation for broken relative file links and stale AST code symbols

parameters.name: check_symbols
parameters.description: Whether to verify code symbol references against AST

entrypoints.name: doc_scaffold
entrypoints.description: Scaffold standardized Diataxis documentation using live Python module AST symbols

parameters.name: module_path
parameters.description: Path to Python source file to generate documentation for

parameters.name: output_path
parameters.description: Destination file path for generated markdown

entrypoints.name: doc_visual_brief
entrypoints.description: Generate interactive HTML coverage brief and scorecard with Mermaid topology diagram

parameters.name: output_path
parameters.description: Target path for HTML brief output
